release_boundary: ARMHF PortMaster community candidate; exact 1.1.2-test.3 executable physically exercised with official APK 22680302 on ArkOS RK3326 Mali-G31; perceived audio sync, exact ZIP, H700 and Mali-450 claims remain pending their own physical tests

not_integrated.nxandroid: the APK's NativeApplication/JNI flow is reproduced by this version-pinned adapter; no generic lifecycle substitution is used
not_integrated.nxobs: host-side support-bundle tooling is not linked or packaged and raw logs are excluded from releases

loader.mapping: owner-supplied ARMv7 ELF loaded directly from the validated APK
loader.softfp_boundary: nxloader softfp libm plus adapter-local proven GLES/math edges
loader.protection: finalize W^X and RELRO before guest execution

jni.policy: only version-observed Android services are implemented; optional analytics, notifications and location surfaces remain inert

graphics.api: OpenGL ES 2 guest on a measured EGL drawable
graphics.provider_ownership: inherited providers are tried untouched first; one coherent provider pair retry is adapter opt-in and capability-gated
graphics.presentation: one framework present after the guest update/render path

audio.format: guest-declared rate/channels converted to firmware-opened S16; test.3 physically opened 44100-Hz stereo S16 with 1024-frame SDL periods
audio.buffering: adapter-local six-period SPSC queue (6144 frames/139 ms at 44100 Hz), 4096-frame guest mix chunks, prefill before unpause, measured software lead at most 233 ms
audio.ownership: guest mixer runs only on the worker; the realtime callback pulls queued PCM or deterministic silence; exit records one aggregate latency/underrun receipt without runtime spam

input.authority: PortMaster/firmware SDL GameController mapping with capability discovery and hotplug generation; adapter-local evdev is an exit-only fallback for stable BTN_SELECT/START and TRIGGER_HAPPY1/2 keycodes
input.menu: right stick moves a code-native polished arrow with radial deadzone, progressive response, smoothing and frame-time integration; A and R3 are equivalent click sources sharing one held touch until the last source releases
input.gameplay: the same global right-stick arrow and A/R3 pointer touch remain available for powers; left stick owns the original SlingshotSystem bridge; while it owns a real dragged bird, fresh A launches through the original release method at the current vector; stick-center release remains a fallback; triggers and D-pad left/right own camera pan/zoom
input.cursor_visibility: global in menus and gameplay; hide after 2000 ms without cursor activity; reappear on right-stick movement or click
input.native_buttons: A and R3 are globally pointer-owned and never emit a competing Android key; B, Start, shoulders and other face buttons retain Android key delivery except for explicitly proven context actions
input.terminal_combo: Select+Start from SDL BACK, exit-only SDL GUIDE or capability-proven evdev keycodes requests the same native pause/deinit exit path; raw button ordinals are never guessed

persistence.owner_data: validated game.apk remains private and is never included in source or release artifacts

terminal.action: Select+Start or native quit request stops guest updates, interrupts and joins an optional native render thread, calls nativePause, stops audio/input, calls nativeDeinit, then _exit(0)

quirks.default: adapter-local authorization only after normal nxgl candidates are exhausted
quirks.selector: exact WINDOW_CREATE/WINDOW_FAILED pre-context report, no inherited provider hint, one same-object provider exporting all required EGL and engine GLES symbols
quirks.effect: bind SDL EGL and GLES provider variables to that same object for one retry, promote only the already-loaded actual providers, then remove temporary environment variables

quirks.default: enabled only for either pinned official owner APK/library signature
quirks.selector: exact 8.0.3-22680302 or 8.0.3-8031 Lua os.clock and SlingshotSystem signatures
quirks.effect: feed a coherent controller snapshot into the original slingshot API without screen-coordinate aiming and route precision-A through the original release method only after a real drag is proven
